requiredDocuments: None required to complete assessment. Some may be required once assigned to a caseworker.

Coast Guard veterans and their immediate family are eligible from their separation date until 365 days past end of tour of service -Discharged service members (if discharged honorably) and their immediate family members until 365 days past end of tour of service, retirement date or discharge date. Foreign military service members who have DOD-issued CAC with MWR/commissary/exchange privileges. -Immediate family members of foreign military active-duty service members registered in Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS).
